notes: All 25 candidate text files read. Two program-list pages: the Melbourne Management recent academic placements page (14 named graduates 2013-2022 with first academic employers; management area, not operations specifically) and the Buffalo School of Management alumni-success PhD filter (12 named PhD alumni with degree years but alumni stories rather than a placement list; mixed areas and some MBA+PhD). Not harvested but worth noting: the Temple Fox 2014 news post states one named placement (Snehal Awate, strategy, to the Indian School of Business) and was classed not-a-list as a news item per the brief; the Texas Tech Rawls Ph.D. Placements page is only an index whose ISQS (Management Information Systems, Operations Management, Statistics) child page (pagesBelow=1, isqs.php) is the page that may carry names. Institutions by host were kept for every page; none plainly belongs to another institution. Three UPF TALN thesis records and the UCD Wolfe lab list are single-person or lab thesis pages outside operations/management and were marked not-a-list.
